description: Rivet provides infrastructure components for durable actors, agent runtimes, workflows, and dynamic app deployment. Its products let developers run stateful backends and AI-agent-related workloads locally or on Rivet Cloud.
summary: Rivet exposes an OAuth-protected hosted MCP server at mcp.rivet.dev, a cloud control-plane HTTP API at api.rivet.dev used by Actors/Dynamic Apps tooling, and an npm-distributed `rivet` CLI for deploy/dev workflows.
